title: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 2, Fugue 4 in C-sharp minor

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (4 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Alto: a figure from the subject (5 times). Bass: a figure from the subject (4 times) and the opening of the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Returns in Episode 3 (bars 31–47).
sections.leads: Between two statements in C♯ minor; perfect cadence in F♯ minor at bar 15; perfect cadence in C♯ minor at bar 16

sections.label: Subject in C♯ minor (Soprano); Subject in G♯ minor (Alto)
Link
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: a figure from the subject. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From G♯ minor to E major; perfect cadence in E major at bar 20

sections.label: Episode 2
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint, in a sequence rising by a third every half bar. Alto: free counterpoint. Bass: a figure from the subject (3 times), in a sequence rising by a third every half bar.
sections.leads: From E major to B major

sections.label: Episode 3
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 1 (bars 6–15) in part, in the same voices, a fifth higher. Soprano: a figure from the subject (3 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times) and the opening of the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Alto: a figure from the subject (5 times) and the opening of the subject (3 times) and a figure from countersubject 2. Bass: a figure from the subject (7 times) and a figure from countersubject 2 and a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar.
sections.leads: Between two statements in C♯ minor

sections.label: Subject in C♯ minor, rhythm varied (Soprano)
Episode 4
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject and the opening of the subject and the opening of the subject, inverted, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Alto: the opening of countersubject 2 and the opening of the subject, inverted and a figure from the subject and a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Bass: the opening of the subject and a figure from the subject and the opening of countersubject 2.
sections.leads: Between two statements in C♯ minor; perfect cadence in A major at bar 53

sections.label: Subject in C♯ minor, rhythm varied (Bass)
Episode 5
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Alto: a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Bass: a figure from countersubject 2 (2 times).
sections.leads: From C♯ minor to G♯ minor; perfect cadence in C♯ minor at bar 57

sections.label: Episode 6
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (3 times). Alto: a figure from the subject (3 times). Bass: a figure from the subject (3 times), in a sequence falling by a fifth every half bar.
sections.leads: From G♯ minor to C♯ minor
